BACKGROUND

A little background

“Old Town” appears on Say Sue Me's second album, Where We Were Together, released on April 13, 2018. Sumi Choi wrote the lyrics and Byungkyu Kim composed the music.

  • Say Sue Me — official album release notes and credits (English and Korean) ↗

INSIDE THE LYRICS

The places remain, the friends have gone

  • Friends moving away
  • Staying or leaving
  • Familiar places

The speaker feels left behind as friends leave town. Each wish to go meets a wish to stay, and the order keeps reversing. Neither choice becomes a settled answer: leaving might change their situation, but attachment to the town remains.

Later, the speaker addresses someone absent, reporting that their familiar street and beach are still there. These ordinary updates make the separation clearer: the places remain available, but spending time there together is no longer possible in the same way. The town still has crowds, yet the speaker feels empty. What is missing is particular company, rather than people in general.

ABOUT THE ARTIST / 세이수미

Say Sue Me

Say Sue Me are an indie rock band from Busan, where their rehearsal and recording space sits a short walk from Gwangalli Beach. Vocalist and guitarist Sumi Choi writes lyrics in both English and Korean.

The band formed in 2012 and released their debut album, We've Sobered Up, in 2014. They signed with British label Damnably in 2017.
